name: gemcomplete
description: High-performance, security-first AI inline code completion for all languages powered by Google Gemini API.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: GemComplete supports inline code completions in all workspaces.

gemcomplete.enabled.description: Enable or disable GemComplete inline completions.

gemcomplete.model.description: The primary Gemini model to use for code completions.

gemcomplete.fallbackModels.description: Fallback Gemini models to try in order if the primary model returns a rate limit (HTTP 429) or transient error.

gemcomplete.debounceMs.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds to wait after typing stops before querying the Gemini API.

gemcomplete.maxPrefixChars.description: Maximum number of characters of code before the cursor to send as context.

gemcomplete.maxSuffixChars.description: Maximum number of characters of code after the cursor to send as context.

gemcomplete.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in a completion suggestion.

gemcomplete.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for generation. Lower values provide more deterministic code completions.

gemcomplete.disabledLanguages.description: List of language IDs where inline completions should not be offered.

gemcomplete.excludeGlobs.description: Glob patterns for sensitive files that will NEVER have context sent to the API.

gemcomplete.customRedactionPatterns.description: User-defined regular expressions whose matches are redacted to [REDACTED] prior to sending to the API.

gemcomplete.privateMode.description: When enabled, GemComplete operates in strict private mode: absolutely no network requests are sent.

gemcomplete.includeOtherOpenTabs.description: Optionally include short redacted snippets from other open editor tabs as contextual assistance.

gemcomplete.maxFileSizeKB.description: Maximum file size in kilobytes eligible for inline completions.

gemcomplete.apiEndpoint.description: Gemini API endpoint base URL. Must start with https:// and match generativelanguage.googleapis.com unless explicitly overridden.

scripts.test: npm run compile && mocha -r ./tests/mockVscode.js --ui tdd --timeout 10000 out/tests/**/*.test.js
